description: This file contains Python source code for a JSON schema loader and parser, including classes for JSON types, error handling, and functions for loading and processing JSON schemas with references and custom adjustments.

classes.name: JsonType
classes.description: Base class representing a JSON type with properties for name, description, and type-specific attributes.

classes.name: JsonNative
classes.description: Marker class for native JSON types.

classes.name: JsonNumber
classes.description: Represents a JSON number type with size and sign attributes.

classes.name: JsonInteger
classes.description: Represents a JSON integer type, inherits from JsonNumber.

classes.name: JsonRefCounted
classes.description: Mixin class for reference counting of JSON objects.

classes.name: JsonEnum
classes.description: Represents a JSON enum type with enumerators and size determination.

classes.name: JsonObject
classes.description: Represents a JSON object with properties, nested objects, and enums.

classes.name: JsonArray
classes.description: Represents a JSON array with item type and copy constructor logic.

classes.name: JsonMethod
classes.description: Represents a JSON method with parameters, results, and metadata.

classes.name: JsonNotification
classes.description: Represents a JSON notification, inheriting from JsonMethod.

classes.name: JsonProperty
classes.description: Represents a JSON property with access modifiers and endpoint names.

classes.name: JsonRpcSchema
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC schema with methods, info, and include handling.

methods.name: Tstring
methods.description: Returns a string wrapped in a specific macro format.

methods.name: Scoped
methods.description: Generates a scoped name for a JSON object based on its hierarchy.

methods.name: CoreJson
methods.description: Constructs a core JSON type string with prefix.

methods.name: MakeObject
methods.description: Creates a standardized object type name.

methods.name: MakeEnum
methods.description: Creates a standardized enum type name.

methods.name: JsonItem
methods.description: Factory function to create JSON type instances based on schema.

methods.name: LoadSchema
methods.description: Loads and processes a JSON schema file, resolving references and adjusting schema structure.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Main entry point to load schemas from a file, handling header files and JSON schemas.
